name: 2018-2c-parcial2
title: ISW1COIN Fintech
description: A fintech that manages ISW1COIN wallets identified by id, with slow (2%, 1 hour) and fast (4%, 10 minutes) transfers whose deposits stay pending until credited, immutable transaction records, no negative balances and a rejected 23:00-23:59:59 crediting window. The student must build the model from scratch with TDD.

design.notes: Slow/fast transfers, withdrawal/deposit legs and pending/credited transactions invite polymorphism instead of flags, time must be simulated through a clock collaborator, balances are computed by folding over transactions with units (Aconcagua), and the wallet is hidden behind ids.
